title: Tensor compatibility of the compactification graph transfer before pushforward
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, e:V→W a separated étale map of schemes, and c=(V→Z→W) a compactification [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-open-immersion]. Put T=Z×_W V, q:T→V, s:T→Z, H=Dj_!, and J=D(e*)K on the ordinary unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let t:Lq*→H⋙Ls* be compactificationEtaleGraphMap, the specified clopen graph transfer. Define d:Ls*HM ⊗ Lq*J → Ls*H(M⊗J) as follows: use the inverse exact/left-derived comparison in J, then the pullback-square comparison Lq*Le*→Ls*Lr*, the inverse tensor comparison for s, and Ls* of the inverse open projection followed by the compactification-composition and exact/left-derived comparisons [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor, def-kun-projection-formula-map, def-pur-supported-localization-comparisons]. Then t_(M⊗J) = μ_q ; (t_M⊗1) ; d, with μ_q the canonical pullback tensor comparison. No quasi-compactness or boundedness is imposed.

proof.text: Check the graph geometry. The base change $q$ of $r$ is proper and hence separated. Since $q\sigma=1$, the section lemma makes $\sigma$ closed. The base change $q_Z$ of $e$ is etale; $q_Z\sigma=j$ is etale because $j$ is open. Etale cancellation makes $\sigma$ etale. A section is a monomorphism: apply $q$ to cancel it. By the definition of etale, $\sigma$ is flat and locally of finite presentation, so the flat locally finitely presented monomorphism lemma makes it open. No quasi-compactness of $j$ was used.

Use the source-library clopen adjunctions S ⊣ H and H ⊣ S, where S is derived restriction and H is extension by zero. Their counit and unit are inverse. For the canonical pullback tensor isomorphism δ, transpose the right-adjoint projection map along S ⊣ H. The unit/projection mate equation and the inverse-unit counit show that this map is the inverse left-adjoint projection map. Identify that left-adjoint map with the existing open projection map after the exact/left-derived transport. Naturality of the projection map and the counit then prove that tensoring clopenTransfer(ψ) with N is the transfer of δ ; (ψ tensor id) ; δ inverse. These are private proved categorical calculations, not a derived clopen-product assumption.

proof.text: Normalize the graph isomorphism before transfer. The section comparison α for σ followed by q is monoidal: derive monoidality of identity pullback from monoidality of its self-composition and the right unit law, then cancel the σ,q compositor. For β:Li*≅Ls* followed by Lσ*, use the pullback-composition tensor equation. The open adjunction unit followed by pullback of the open projection hom and the tensor comparison equals the unit tensored with identity; this is the defining projection-map transpose equation. For the coefficient factor, expand the square comparison and the compactification comparison, apply associativity for σ,s,g and σ,q,e, and cancel compositors; the left identity law and naturality identify the resulting coefficient map with α. Substitute these three identities into the tensor expression. Naturality of β and of the open unit, followed by cancellation of the coefficient isomorphism and its inverse, proves the displayed graph-isomorphism normalization. No transfer occurs in this private helper.

proof.text: Apply the clopen-transfer tensor identity from step 2 to the graph isomorphism. Move the initial pullback tensor comparison and the final sfEtaleGraphTensorMap across transfer using clopenTransfer_comp. The remaining equality is exactly the graph-isomorphism normalization of step 3. This proves the original theorem with its explicit map, without clopen derived-category decomposition, geometric-stalk detection of equality, quasi-compactness, or boundedness.

theorem sfEtaleGraphTransferTensor
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {V W : Scheme.{u}} (e : V ⟶ W) [Etale e] [IsSeparated e]
    (c : Compactification e)
    (M : DerivedCategoryModule A V) (K : DerivedCategoryModule A W) :
    (compactificationEtaleGraphMap A e c).app
        (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) V).obj M).obj
          (D((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K)) =
      (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd c.g e) M
        (D((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K)).hom ≫
      ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback c.g e)).map
        ((compactificationEtaleGraphMap A e c).app M)).app
          (L((pullback.snd c.g e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj
            (D((e)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K)) ≫
      sfEtaleGraphTensorMap A e c M K
